what_a_verdict_means.AMEND: the row stands in substance, but a named defect is owed a correction, made by the drafting seat as a superseding row and judged by one that did not make it
what_a_verdict_means.REJECT: the row is wrong; it returns to the drafting seat
what_a_verdict_means.CONFIRM: the finding or measure is right as made
what_a_verdict_means.CORRECT: the finding or measure is wrong, and what is owed is named
what_a_verdict_means.lean: for a companion or widening row only: whether gate2 would admit it into this pin; admission is his word
